about: Bare colours the stylesheets, scripts and templates still have (css_color_census.test.mjs, #5375): file::value -> uses. The counts only go down.

reasons.board_export_render.js: the exported board is a standalone HTML file: it has no page tokens, its own palette is inline
reasons.file_explorer.js: file type icon colours are data (the brand colour of each language) and the folder glyph's grey, not theme colours
reasons.board_accents.js: the default of a board's colour picker (the accent's value, a user choice is stored as a hex)
reasons.folder_tags.js: the default of a folder tag's colour picker
reasons.html_escape.js: the fallback for a tag colour that is not a hex
reasons.mobile_connect.js: the QR code is drawn on white in both themes: a code on a dark panel does not scan
reasons.native.js: the desktop shell's own window chrome, drawn before the page's tokens exist
reasons.theme_config.js: a colour input's value when a token is empty
reasons.xterm_renderer.js: the terminal's fallbacks when its theme variables are missing
reasons.templates/index.html: the document's theme-color meta (the browser chrome before the CSS loads)
reasons.templates/history_session.html: the default value of a colour input
reasons.css: what is left in the stylesheets: a colour that equals a theme token's value in ONE theme only (a #e05545 that is the dark --error), kept as it renders today (no visual change) and listed here as the next job: each is a light-theme leak to fix with its own screenshot
